collection.compiler_build: Common source/build paths and verified stage0/LLVM/optimized developer recipe for baseline and candidates. Keep exact compiler driver identities and all shared runtime file checks. Verify focused correctness tests.
collection.contexts: Use the proven SDK12 encoder capture/collector. Bind fresh actual ordinary library test-build argv and ordered environment, retaining eight compiler threads, exact namespace substitutions only, and dead jobserver exclusion. Check all actual emitted output classes and source/tool/runtime guards before effects.
collection.cpus: Controller CPU8 and measured process CPUs0–7 with eight compiler threads. Separate all heavy builders from the measurement window.
collection.edit: Use the known equal-length comment fixture. Before every sample, warm on BEFORE with native Cargo and capture the exact ordinary library compiler invocation. Measure once on AFTER and restore original source/mode. Restore/converge each arm at block end.
collection.state: Fresh independent per-arm target/shared/package/runtime banks at one new common physical path, using the same exact SDK12 compiler pair and fixed released Cargo. Import immutable source/locked archives only. Before the first block, warm and trace both original check and test --no-run commands as fresh in each arm; restore both endpoints at each block end.
collection.validity: Require exit success, expected source/target/output kinds, complete raw final Ir matching self-cost sum and stderr, input/output context integrity, restoration and parked state. Record host observations without filtering count results. Preserve technical failures and correct the cause before fresh collection. Any technical failure ends the complete attempt before effects; replacements require a separate prospective decision. No automatic retry.

lazy_worker_caches_test_build.endpoint: ordinary uv library rustc invocation captured from cargo -Zohm-defaults=yes test --no-run --locked --offline -j8
lazy_worker_caches_test_build.purpose: Independently confirm this same isolated cache-storage candidate on the test-build workflow; no tests execute.

condition.requires: both primary check blocks valid and passing their original gates

design.method: Paired geometric baseline/candidate ratios with the existing paired_count_statistics reader. Report reduction as 1 minus reciprocal ratio. Exact two-sided sign p reported per block.
design.metric: whole isolated ordinary rustc final Callgrind Ir, inclusive of its own worker threads and procedural macros
design.statistical_scope: Nominal per-block intervals and sign tests. Pair scheduling and exchangeability assumptions apply. Each endpoint has its own claim.
design.stopping: Stop on the first valid block failing either gate. No extra pairs, retries of valid failures, or pooling with SDK6. Report per-block results and order effects.

public_derivative: Only private source-reference paths and unbound authorization slots are omitted; all counts, schedules, seeds, gates and collection boundaries are unchanged.
publication: A check-qualified draft may proceed while this conditional secondary runs. Only two valid passing test-build blocks permit a test-build instruction claim. No native wall-time or whole-Cargo claim follows from this isolated rustc metric.
scope: Separate prospective ordinary test-build compiler replication, conditional on both primary dirty-check blocks qualifying. No cross-endpoint pooling.
